name: MailMate
install: `brew install --cask mailmate`. The trial is fully functional.
account: Settings ▸ Accounts ▸ +. Host 127.0.0.1, the corpus's port, Security None.
parity: MailMate keeps full messages locally by default. Nothing to change.
reset: Remove the Bench account in Settings ▸ Accounts and quit MailMate.
Press Enter here, then add the account again.

layout.note: Default layout: the list is a band across the top (18pt rows) and the reader is below it. The main window's title always carries the mailbox name; a stray Return opens a message in a window of its own, which the harness closes.

caveats.text: MailMate searches when Return is pressed, not as you type, so its time includes the Return.
The whole MailMate support directory, which on a machine with other accounts includes them too.
